2607.08540.title: Improving Ad-hoc Search Effectiveness for Conversational Information Retrieval via Model Merging
2607.08540.paper_summary: Conversational information retrieval is challenging since it requires the consideration of the conversation history which potentially gives rise to topic shifts and coreference resolution across previous turns. To address these challenges, previous work mainly rely on traditional fine-tuning of ad-hoc retrievers on conversational datasets or extrapolates their generalizability through multi-tasking. However, this mainstream approach is costly - since it requires model re-training - and exhibits catastrophic forgetting, where the model loses its foundational ad-hoc retrieval performance. In this paper, we fill this gap by introducing model merging as a training-free strategy enabling the design of a single retrieval model that operates across both ad-hoc and conversational settings with no additional fine-tuning. We conduct experiments using linear and non-linear parameter-wise merging strategies - namely Model Soup and Slerp - on standard ad-hoc search and conversational retrieval datasets. Our results demonstrate that model merging significantly enhances the ad-hoc search capabilities of conversational retrievers while improving generalizability across task-specific datasets, achieving up to 15% higher NDCG@3 under zero-shot conditions.
2607.08540.paper_summary_zh: 對話式信息檢索具有挑戰性，因為它需要考慮對話歷史，這可能導致主題轉變和對前幾輪的共指解析。為了解決這些挑戰，以往的研究主要依賴於在對話數據集上對臨時檢索器進行傳統的微調，或通過多任務學習推斷其可泛化性。然而，這種主流方法成本高昂，因為它需要重新訓練模型，並且表現出災難性遺忘，即模型失去其基礎的臨時檢索性能。在本文中，我們通過引入模型合併作為一種無需訓練的策略來填補這一空白，使得設計一個在臨時和對話設置中都能運作的單一檢索模型成為可能，且無需額外的微調。我們使用線性和非線性的參數合併策略進行實驗，即模型湯（Model Soup）和Slerp，在標準的臨時搜索和對話檢索數據集上進行測試。我們的結果表明，模型合併顯著提高了對話檢索器的臨時搜索能力，同時改善了在任務特定數據集上的可泛化性，在零樣本條件下達到高達15%的NDCG@3提升。
